WITH transaction_mixes AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, 'NULL') AS order_mix,
    COUNT(*) AS mix_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, 'NULL')
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(mix_count) AS total_count,
    COUNT(*) AS num_mixes,
    1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_share
  FROM transaction_mixes
),
mix_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    tm.order_mix,
    tm.mix_count,
    tm.mix_count * 1.0 / s.total_count AS share,
    s.avg_share
  FROM transaction_mixes tm
  CROSS JOIN stats s
)
SELECT 
  order_mix,
  mix_count,
  share,
  share - avg_share AS above_average
FROM mix_analysis
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC;
